dialogues.speaker: Loumelat
dialogues.text: It means "the right path or calling." That's "Rashid"! It's an expression they use back in my hometown, and also a part of my name.

dialogues.speaker: Loumelat
dialogues.text: I believe everything has its Rashid. I'm drawn to fishing, and the fish are drawn to me.

dialogues.speaker: Loumelat
dialogues.text: Hehe, have you found your own Rashid?
